```{r}
# Paquetes
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(knitr)
library(here)

knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = here())

# --- Carga de datos ---
csv_path <- here("Datos","Base de datos depurada","CRON2W4_clean.csv")
stopifnot(file.exists(csv_path))
df <- read.csv(csv_path, na.strings = c("", "NA"))
# Objetivo: explorar la relación entre salud mental, confianza institucional y nivel educativo usando CRONOS2 Wave 4.
# Salud mental (1-4): se invierten los ítems negativos y se calcula media por persona.
# Confianza (0-10): media de w4q61-w4q63.
# Se tratan códigos 77/88/99 como NA.
neg  <- c("w4q47","w4q48","w4q49","w4q51","w4q53","w4q54",
          "w4q55","w4q56","w4q57","w4q58","w4q59","w4q60")
pos  <- c("w4q50","w4q52")
conf <- c("w4q61","w4q62","w4q63")
cols_exist <- intersect(c(neg,pos,conf), names(df))

df2 <- df %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(cols_exist), ~ suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.)))) %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(cols_exist), ~ replace(., . %in% c(77,88,99), NA))) %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(intersect(c(neg,pos), names(.))), ~ ifelse(. < 1 | . > 4,  NA, .))) %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(intersect(conf,    names(.))), ~ ifelse(. < 0 | . > 10, NA, .))) %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(intersect(neg, names(.))), ~ 5 - .)) %>%
  mutate(
    mh_index   = rowMeans(across(all_of(intersect(c(neg,pos), names(.)))), na.rm = TRUE),
    conf_index = rowMeans(across(all_of(intersect(conf,    names(.)))),    na.rm = TRUE)
  )

# Tabla resumen
tab_resumen <- df2 %>%
  summarise(
    `Salud mental (1–4)`    = mean(mh_index,   na.rm = TRUE),
    `Confianza (0–10)`      = mean(conf_index, na.rm = TRUE),
    `Nivel educativo (1–7)` = mean(eisced,     na.rm = TRUE),
    n = dplyr::n()
  )
kable(tab_resumen, digits = 2, align = "r")
#Gráfico principal. 
# La pendiente del ajuste lineal sugiere que a mayor confianza institucional media, mayor bienestar psicológico. 
ggplot(df2, aes(x = mh_index, y = conf_index)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.20) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "steelblue") +
  labs(title = "Salud mental vs. Confianza institucional",
       x = "Salud mental (1–4, alto = mejor)",
       y = "Confianza institucional (0–10)") +
  theme_minimal()

```
